description: Address 6 review issues: CONSTELLATIONS layer re-registration, setWarmthOffset implementation, frame-rate-independent decay, frame-gap flash prevention, RipplePropagation integration, and CuriosityBehavior reduced-motion fallback.
steps: Step 1: Fix CONSTELLATIONS layer - Scene004 must re-register a render function using a ConnectionRenderer instance and the captured particle indices.
Step 2: Add setWarmthOffset method to LightingEngine that blends warmth into the current color.
Step 3: Fix frame-rate-dependent decay in InfluenceEngine and RipplePropagation using Math.pow(decayRate, deltaTime * 60).
Step 4: Fix frame-gap flash by having Engine.js activate environment on Scene004 before Scene003 leaves, or have Scene003 skip deactivation when transitioning forward.
Step 5: Integrate RipplePropagation wavefront into CuriosityBehavior so it has behavioral effect.
Step 6: Add reduced-motion fallback to CuriosityBehavior (dampen forces when reduced motion is active).
acceptance_criteria: Scene004 re-registers a CONSTELLATIONS layer renderer using ConnectionRenderer + captured particles
LightingEngine has setWarmthOffset(value) method that blends warmth into current color
InfluenceEngine.update uses time-based decay: Math.pow(decayRate, deltaTime * 60)
No frame-gap flash between Scene003 and Scene004
CuriosityBehavior queries RipplePropagation wavefront for additional influence
CuriosityBehavior has reduced-motion fallback that reduces force vectors
All modified files pass NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check
